content:
Multiplication in Class 3 covers the tables and 2- and 3-digit by 1-digit products — core Maths Olympiad Class 3 content. Here is what it tests, the facts to memorise, the common mix-ups, and a free 10-question test.

What the Class 3 Maths Olympiad Multiplication chapter tests

  • Multiplication tables and facts
  • 2- and 3-digit by 1-digit multiplication
  • Multiplying by 10 and 100
  • Properties (order, ×1, ×0) and word problems

Key facts your child should know

  • Multiply the ones, then tens, then hundreds, carrying as you go.
  • × 10 adds one zero; × 100 adds two zeros.
  • Order does not matter: 6 × 7 = 7 × 6.
  • × 1 leaves a number unchanged; × 0 gives 0.

Common mistakes to avoid

  • Forgetting to carry during column multiplication.
  • Adding the wrong number of zeros for × 10 / × 100.
  • Slipping on a table fact (7 × 8).
